page.title: Operations
page.purpose: Show what the scenario can do right now given installed models and available GPU headroom, and make the next action obvious without hiding why an operation is unavailable.

priorities.statement: An operation that cannot run right now says why — missing model, insufficient VRAM, or restricted licence lane — rather than failing after submission.
GPU headroom is visible before work is submitted, not discovered through an out-of-memory failure.

states.description: Models installed and GPU headroom available.
Another tenant holds the VRAM this operation needs.
No models installed; only deterministic operations are available.
Operations available only at a reduced profile rung.

elements.description: Current GPU headroom against what the selected operation requires.
Why an unavailable operation cannot run.

claims.statement: GPU headroom is shown on the operations surface before any operation is submitted.
When an operation is unavailable the surface names the specific reason.
Deterministic operations remain listed and usable when no models are installed.
